verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is an AI-native email client that processes inbox content with AI (Auto Labels, Auto Drafts, Ask AI), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a no-training commitment or an opt-out control. The community concern about Superhuman storing emails on its servers is about data retention, not model training, so it doesn't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
